title: CandidateQuestionsStep
description: Config for the in-session candidate Q&A step that fires after a prescreen terminal (default: PASS only). Authored per job at pa-jobs/{jobId}.prescreenConfig.candidateQuestionsStep. Claire answers only from approvedFaqs + level1Reveal + companyCultureDoc; everything else hits a refusalCategory.

enabled.description: Master switch. If false, no candidate Q&A step is offered regardless of trigger.

trigger.description: When the step fires. v1 default: post_pass_only. candidate_initiated allows mid-conversation invocation but is a runtime-implementation flag.

maxQuestionsPerSession.description: Hard cap on candidate questions answered per session. 0 effectively disables answering while keeping the step structure (rare).

companyCultureDoc.description: Employer-authored bounded blurb about culture / team / working model. One paragraph; no nested structure.

id.description: Stable id for the FAQ entry. Used in transcript classifiedCategory as 'faq:<id>'.

question.description: Canonical phrasing of the question. LLM does semantic match against candidate input.

tags.description: Optional topical tags to assist semantic matching (e.g. 'team_size', 'remote_policy').

category.description: Stable category key. Recommended built-ins: comp_specifics_beyond_range, legal_immigration_advice, safety_sensitive, interview_process_unknown, salary_negotiation, competing_offers, out_of_scope_general, unclassifiable_low_confidence.

hitlOnHit.description: If true, every hit on this category writes a pa-prescreen-hitl-flags doc on first occurrence.

sensitiveCategories.description: Category keys that fire HITL on first hit regardless of count.

minLlmClassifyConfidence.description: If LLM classifier confidence falls below this twice in a row, fire unclassifiable HITL flag.

examples.companyCultureDoc: We're a 35-person Series-B fintech building developer-facing payment rails. Hybrid in SF (Tue/Wed/Thu in office). Engineering organized into squads of 4-6 with strong staff-eng technical leadership. We ship every weekday and on-call rotates ~once per 6 weeks.

answer.zh: 我们目前是 SF 混合办公，每周二三四到办公室，其他天可以远程。
answer.en: We're SF-hybrid: Tue/Wed/Thu in office, other days remote.

approvedFaqs.question: How big is the engineering team?

answer.zh: 工程团队大约 35 人，分成 4-6 人的小组。
answer.en: Engineering is about 35 people, organized into squads of 4-6.

answer.zh: 这一步之后会有一轮技术深聊、一轮 onsite（含系统设计 + 编码 + 团队对话），整个流程约两周。
answer.en: After this step: one technical deep-dive, then onsite (system design + coding + team conversations). Roughly two weeks end to end.

refusal.zh: 我只能分享公开的薪资范围，具体 offer 由招聘团队和你直接谈。
refusal.en: I can only share the posted range. The full offer band is between you and the hiring team.

refusal.zh: 我没法给签证或法律建议，建议咨询专业律师。
refusal.en: I'm not able to give immigration or legal advice. Please consult a qualified advisor.

refusal.zh: 这个细节我这边没有，招聘团队会在后续告诉你。
refusal.en: I don't have that detail; the hiring team will share it in the next step.

refusal.zh: 了解，我会把这个情况同步给团队。
refusal.en: Noted — I'll flag this to the team.
Let's keep this about the role.

refusal.zh: 这个问题我没完全 get 到，能换个说法吗？
refusal.en: I didn't quite get that — could you rephrase?
